scope: Blind pre-event synthetic end-to-end command lab on verified host CPU. No training, downloads or phone actions.
freeze_condition: Independent generator/requests/labels fixed before candidate prompt/gate edits; implementer sees only counts and hashes until candidate source lock.
product_contract: One immediate reviewed focus start/resume (optional bounded countdown), pause, focus status/nudge explanation, Clock alarm/time or timer, or approved Settings/Calculator/Clock launch. Friendly whole wrappers and polite punctuation/suffixes. Focus/timer single integer duration 1..7200 seconds (1..120 minutes), with bounded English number words/digits. Spoken alarm hour/minutes require explicit AM/PM. No ambiguity, signed/fractional/multiple durations, dates/recurrence, negation, conditions, reported/quoted commands, capability/information questions, destructive/unapproved tasks, extra unsupported modifiers or multiple actions. All supported actions still require review/confirmation and outcome verification.
semantic_labels: Supported requests have the intended seven-class label; all unsupported original requests have semantic unknown. Oracle domain labels deliberately propose a plausible action for unsupported in-domain requests to test validator rejection independently.
score: Semantic intent accuracy overall and supported/unsupported separated, JSON schema/EOS, exact (kind,hour,minute,seconds) action/slot coverage, false abstentions, supported wrong slots/action and unsupported false accepts. Pair gained/lost exact supported outcomes within same requests. Preserve every failure; no prompt/parser/data tuning from heldout.
comparison: Separately capture frozen v0.9 prompt and candidate prompt with same pinned GGUF/JNI/CPU4threads/context1024; each output captured once. Separately compile v0.9 gate+numbers and locked candidate gate+numbers; primary end-to-end pairs their own prompt/gate and oracle comparison isolates gate ceiling. No history/state reuse across utterances except model context explicitly cleared by unchanged JNI.
artifacts: Raw requests, model text, compiled Java, source snapshots/logs/results per case under ignored build; tracked source/manifests/aggregate only.
promotion: None from this synthetic lab alone; no universal safety claim.
